reason: Verified line by line and by driving: all 14 writes to openNoteId in src/tasks.js (52, 550, 562, 669, 2837, 2907, 3106, 3328, 3485, 3641, 4194, 4382) assign null, so on tasks.board aria-expanded is only ever 'false', draggable only ever 'true', data-open count is 0, the five [data-open] rules (tasks.css 954, 956-957, 1179, 1976) can never match, and the Escape branch's 'Note closed.' is unreachable — pressing a card body opens .taskPanel and says 'Task open.'/'Task closed.' instead. sharpenedFix: Delete the dead state, but do not delete the aria-expanded term wholesale: src/tasks.css:950 (`.card[aria-expanded]:hover .cardNote { color: var(--ink-1) }`) matches on attribute PRESENCE and is live today — it is what darkens a note under the pointer. Rewrite that selector to `.card:has(.cardNote):hover .cardNote` (or `.card[data-has-note]:hover`) in the same edit, then remove openNoteId, the aria-expanded and data-open terms, the Escape branch at 2834-2839, and the five CSS rules.
